row.notes: Builds one game_modes row (available, game_mode_type, ...); for championship modes calls 0x1407d2820 (0x1407cbd22). When the row's register_save_container is true it inserts the mode's container (mode object +0x260, named by save_data.name) into the save root's child set (SaveDataSystem *(this+0x138), set at +0x158, attach 0x143651ee0 to system+0x20 at 0x1407cf910). So each registered mode is a top-level container of the profile save; a mode missing from the database has no child there. save-v2 (L2): allocates the 0x2a0-byte mode object from this+0x10, copies the game_modes row name (Gdb_Get_RowName, XOR-decoded, at most 31 chars) into the inline buffer +0x280..+0x29f, stores char *name = obj+0x280 at +0x278 (capacity 0x20 at +0x270) and the built mode (championship builder 0x1407d2820 etc.) at +0x260.
